results.name: Browser Interface Loading
results.test_performed: Verified index.html, styles.css (dark theme), app.js routing, and Chrome Headless Shell binary
results.expected: HTML loaded with title, stylesheet (11.5KB+), client script (20KB+), Chromium 158 available
results.actual: HTML 200 OK, CSS 200 OK (26721 bytes), JS 200 OK (51888 bytes)

results.name: Media Library Scanning
results.expected: Discovers files across public/footage, music, sound-effects, and qa/ subfolders
results.actual: Discovered 30 total media assets (13 footage, 3 music)

results.name: Video Import & Metadata Extraction
results.test_performed: FFprobe metadata analysis across 4 real test clips (1080p, 4K, 9:16, speech)
results.expected: Accurate resolution, duration, FPS, and aspect ratio parsed for all files

results.name: Video Preview & HTTP 206 Streaming
results.test_performed: HTTP Range requests (bytes 0-1MB and bytes 1MB-2MB forward scrub)
results.expected: HTTP 206 Partial Content with Content-Range, Accept-Ranges: bytes, video/mp4

results.name: Drag-and-Drop Timeline Operations
results.test_performed: Drop event simulation mapping client coordinates to dropTime and trackId
results.expected: Generates valid non-destructive clip schema with target track, startTime, and sourceIn
results.actual: Clip 'qa_1080p_landscape.mp4' dropped to track-video-1 at t=2.0s

results.name: Clip Selection & Movement
results.test_performed: Interactive clip drag simulation (delta +3.5s) and duration recalculation
results.expected: Clip startTime updates to 5.5s, boundaries respected, total duration matches

results.name: Left/Right Non-Destructive Trimming
results.expected: startTime = 3.5s, sourceIn = 1.5s, duration = 3.5s, sourceDuration preserved at 10.0s

results.name: Split & Delete Operations
results.test_performed: Split clip at t=2.5s followed by clip deletion by ID
results.expected: Original 6.0s clip accurately split into 2.5s & 3.5s parts; deletion cleans array

results.name: Playhead Seeking & Frame Accuracy
results.test_performed: Timecode calculation at 30 FPS and timeline edge boundary clamping

results.name: Track Controls & Speech Audio Ducking
results.test_performed: Multi-track hierarchy toggles (V1, V2, A1, A2) and dynamic audio ducking math
results.expected: Track muting state tracked; music ducks from 75% to 26.2% (-65%) during speech
results.actual: V2 muted: True, Normal Music: 75.0%, Ducked Music: 26.200000000000003%

results.name: Music Waveform & Beat Markers (Librosa)
results.expected: Rhythmic tempo BPM computed with frame-accurate beat markers and downbeat flags
results.actual: Detected Tempo: 60.1 BPM, Total Beats: 29, Downbeats: 8

results.name: AI Subtitle Generation & Editing (Whisper)
results.test_performed: HTTP POST /api/ai/transcribe on real speech dialogue video
results.expected: Word-level timestamps extracted, language identified ('en'), words editable
results.actual: Language: en, Words: 15, Text: 'Welcome to Real Studio Pro. Professional video edi...', Editable: WELCOME_EDITED

results.name: Cinematic Color Presets & Sliders
results.test_performed: Verified all 5 Hollywood LUT presets (teal_orange, moody_monochrome, warm_film, vibrant_pop, vintage_gold) and CSS matrix calculation
results.expected: Presets compile valid FFmpeg curves/colorbalance and real-time CSS filter strings
results.actual: 5/5 presets registered; CSS Filter compiled: 'contrast(1.25) saturate(1.3) brightness(1.05)'

results.name: Transitions & Motion Effects
results.test_performed: Transition pills (none, crossfade, zoomIn, slideLeft, glitch) and motion effects integration
results.expected: Transitions attached to clip schemas; active effects stack maintained in state

results.name: Project Persistence (Save & Reload)
results.expected: 100% data fidelity: 3 clips, 2 subtitles, mixer settings, color preset preserved
results.actual: Saved to Projects/qa_full_project.json; loaded with 3 clips, duration=15.0s

results.name: Export Settings & Progress Polling
results.test_performed: Asynchronous render job polling simulation across 0% -> 25% -> 55% -> 100%
results.expected: Progress bar increments accurately; completed status returns output file details

results.name: Exported Video Playback & Stream Integrity
results.test_performed: FFprobe stream analysis & full FFmpeg decode error pass on Demonstration_Reel.mp4
results.expected: Compliant H.264/AAC MP4 container, valid timestamps, zero frame decode errors
results.actual: Codec: h264/aac, Res: 1080x1920, FPS: 30.0, Duration: 8.60s, Decode Errors: 0
